## What changed?

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change that fixes it.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Release build completes without warnings.
- [ ] Functional self-test passes.
- [ ] Off-screen interface self-test passes when UI code changed.
- [ ] Startup probe passes when startup or packaging code changed.
- [ ] Publish profiles were not changed unless the pull request specifically explains why.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] Existing manifest fields and recoverable backups remain protected.
- [ ] No token, credential, certificate, or personal path was added.
- [ ] New text is understandable to a first-time Winget publisher.
- [ ] Designer-managed controls remain compatible with the Visual Studio WinForms Designer.

## Screenshots

For a visible interface change, include before and after screenshots. Otherwise write `Not applicable`.
